title: Speaking — Getting out of the city
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on getting out of the city.

questions: What do you like about the room you use most?
Is there a part of your home you rarely use?
How long have you lived in your current home?
What would you put in a room of your own?
How often do you leave built-up areas for leisure?
What do you miss when you are away from a city for a long time?

part2.topic: Describe a visit outside the city that gave you a new perspective.
points: what you noticed about daily life
part2.closing: and explain how the visit changed your way of thinking.

questions: What connections benefit both cities and nearby rural areas?
How can rural communities welcome visitors while protecting their way of life?
How has everyday life connected with getting out of the city changed for people of different ages?
